reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: public interface method (ILegionPositionManager) — public API exception applies. Gate 2: attack entry point is the public `transferInvestorPositionWithAuthorization` callable by any untrusted Caller1, no trust_assumptions block. Gate 3: out-of-scope 'signature reuse for investments' does not cover position transfers. An attacker can trigger this via `transferInvestorPositionWithAuthorization` by replaying a previously-consumed signature after a Legion admin legitimately returns a position via `transferInvestorPosition`, causing an unauthorized re-transfer of the investor's position ERC721 without a new authorization. Severity maintained at High: clear spec deviation (no nonce/deadline), sibling contracts use `s_usedSignatures` confirming intentional protection was omitted here.
